record.question: Which country has become the world's largest steel producer in 2019, as per latest report published by World Steel Association (WSA)?
record.explanation: Answer D: China. China was the largest steel producer by crude-steel output. To support a 2019 exam-date claim, cite the latest table available at the exam date or a 2019 monthly production release; a full-year 2019 summary published in 2020 is later evidence. Reference: https://worldsteel.org/media/press-releases/2019/world-crude-steel-production-january-2019/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
